text:
An inn along my road.

With the gesture of a vestal,

you serve the red wine

of a suburban orgy.


The drunks

with lively eyes

and boastful tongues

pay you compliments, oh virago!


And other drunks sigh

for your diamond eyes,

your eyes that look at no one.


At the height of your breasts,

the overflowing tray

arrives in your brown arms.


Oh, woman,

give me also something to drink!

translation.title: Toward Lowland III
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the tavern scene, vestal irony, and final request for drink.
